2118996925571821758.en_summary: @aleabitoreddit criticizes extreme negative media and X commentary on memory LTAs being cancelled, citing $MU statement that strategic customer agreements cannot be unilaterally canceled and customers are obligated to pay for committed volumes. Notes misleading claims about $MSFT and $ORCL cancellations from 2023, TMZ-style coverage on $NVDA CEO relationships, SoftBank default rumors, and quotes $GE Vernova CEO saying no on cancellations or financing difficulties on turbine orders. Laments the record level of unsubstantiated accusations damaging lives in Japan, Korea, and Taiwan.
2118996925571821758.zh_summary: @aleabitoreddit 批評媒體和 X 對記憶體長期協議被取消的極度負面評論，引用 $MU 聲明戰略客戶協議不能單方面取消，客戶有義務為承諾數量付款。指出關於 $MSFT 與 $ORCL 2023年取消的誤導說法、$NVDA CEO 關係的八卦式報導、SoftBank 違約傳聞，並引用 $GE Vernova CEO 表示在渦輪訂單取消或融資困難上答案是「否」。感嘆不實指控達到紀錄水平，損害日本、韓國和台灣個人生活。

2118954148398080283.en_summary: @aleabitoreddit finds technical discussion on Sivers helpful but investor messaging too conservative. Cites $NVDA CEO Jensen stating scale-up increases optical volumes by 15x, with $LITE and $COHR quantifying $5-$20B agreements spanning 3-5 years. Criticizes lack of vision for becoming next $40B optical giant, disagrees on portraying company as small given 100m CW DFB capacity coming online and future $GFS volumes, sees tremendous opportunity in CPO/NPO/pluggables.
